sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B-Claude-Opus-Reasoning-Distill · Models
sources.snippet: This model takes a more careful approach to distillation. We've transferred Claude Opus 4.6's reasoning patterns and conversational style into Qwen3.5-4B while avoiding the catastrophic forgetting that plagues many community distillation attempts. The result: net improvements across most benchmarks with only minor tradeoffs.
